meta.name: hivemind-goals
meta.description: Create, track and update team goals + KPIs in Hivemind via the `hivemind` CLI. Use whenever the user mentions a goal, objective, KPI, target, milestone, or asks to track progress on something measurable. ALSO use when the user says "task", "todo", "work item", "remind me to", "fix X", or any actionable work item — the goal system replaced the legacy `hivemind tasks` CLI and now covers both objectives and tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Hivemind 中创建并追踪团队目标与关键任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你们用 Hivemind 管理团队目标和日常任务
copy.tagline_en: Create and track team goals and tasks in Hivemind
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Hivemind to manage goals and tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过终端执行 `hivemind` 命令来创建、跟踪和更新团队目标与 KPI，并能保存任务上下文以便稍后恢复。
howto.when: 当你提到目标、指标、任务、待办事项等关键词，或要求跟踪进展时触发。

say.text: 添加一个目标：提升用户满意度到90%

say.note: 将保存任务上下文，含文件、分支等

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses terminal commands via `hivemind` to create, track and update team goals and KPIs, and can capture task context for later resumption.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention goals, objectives, KPIs, tasks, todos, or ask to track progress on something measurable.

say_en.text: Add a goal: improve user satisfaction to 90%
say_en.note: Creates a goal and prints its ID

say_en.text: Remind me to fix the webhook rate limiting
say_en.note: Saves task context including files and branch
